answer: Anchor each agent to one zero-knowledge proof of a verified human, like a raven carrying a single sealed letter: no agent flies without it. First, a person verifies once with a checker and gets a credential revealing nothing about them. Second, the agent attaches that proof to every deal, and the ledger rejects any second agent reusing it. Third, abuse revokes it across the whole tundra of services at once. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 verified humans at $50 each, $500,000 in bribes plus 45 days of queues, while one genuine opal of trust, earned slowly, stays hard to counterfeit.
